name: Hybrid Implicit Isosurface Ray Tracing
definition: A ray tracing method integrated into OSPRay that uses the Octant reconstruction method to create a hybrid implicit isosurface geometry, allowing for high-quality, crack-free isosurface rendering of rectilinear volumes.
summary: Hybrid Implicit Isosurface Ray Tracing renders high-quality, crack-free isosurfaces by combining explicit voxel selection with implicit ray-surface intersection, avoiding polygon extraction entirely.
